name: Watermelon

schedule.notes: Peat pots. Don't bother where seasons are long enough to direct-sow.
Tendril nearest the fruit is brown and dry; ground spot turns from white to yellow.

harvest.cues: Tendril at the fruit stem is brown and crisp; ground spot is creamy yellow; tap gives a deep thunk.
harvest.storageNotes: Counter 7 to 10 days; fridge cuts shelf life to 4 days. Cut keeps 3 days in fridge.

varieties.name: Sugar Baby
varieties.notes: 6 to 10 lb. Best for short seasons and small gardens.

varieties.name: Crimson Sweet
varieties.notes: 20 to 25 lb classic stripe. Long season.

notes: Long-season heat lover; in zone 5 or colder use transplants on black plastic. Don't trellis large-fruited types — they need a hammock at minimum. Cut water near harvest for sweeter melons.
